cashCrunch.title: Payroll bounces
cashCrunch.body: The bank called. Not the friendly branch manager, the other one. Payroll didn't clear and the team will find out by lunchtime.

bridgeFromMargot.label: Ask Margot for an emergency bridge
bridgeFromMargot.result: Margot wired the money within the hour. Her email said "we'll talk". You will.

deferSalaries.label: Ask the team to defer pay for six months
deferSalaries.result: They agreed. Nobody made eye contact in the kitchen for a week.
deferSalaries.cause: asked the team to defer their salaries

personalSavings.label: Empty your personal savings
personalSavings.result: You moved fifteen thousand dollars and your sense of security into the company account.

closeTheDoors.label: Close the doors with dignity
closeTheDoors.result: You paid everyone what you could and wrote each of them a reference.

boardVote.title: The board wants a word
boardVote.body: The agenda has one item: "Leadership". The investors have the votes to replace you, and they've been practising the speech.
boardVote.survived: The board backs you, for now. Margot's closing remark was "let's see the next quarter".

rallyMargot.label: Call Margot before the meeting
rallyMargot.result: Margot swings the vote. She also reminds you, twice, that she swung it.

cofounderStands.label: Ask your co-founder to stand with you
cofounderStands.result: Your co-founder says the company goes nowhere without you. The room goes quiet. You stay.

turnaroundPlan.label: Present a turnaround plan
turnaroundPlan.result: Twenty slides, three scenarios and one very long silence.

stepDown.label: Step down gracefully
stepDown.result: You resign before they can vote. The press release calls it "a natural transition".

scandalCollapse.title: It's everywhere
scandalCollapse.body: The story has a hashtag. Customers are leaving, staff are leaking and your lawyer has stopped answering. There's no way back from this.

pressConference.label: Hold a press conference
pressConference.result: You read a statement. A reporter asked a follow-up. That was the end.

notesAppApology.label: Post an apology from your notes app
notesAppApology.result: The apology had a typo in the word "sincerely". It did not help.

moveToLisbon.label: Move to Lisbon and start a podcast
moveToLisbon.result: Episode one is called "What I Learned". It's four hours long.

dataBreach.title: Data breach
dataBreach.body: Someone got into your user database. Emails, hashed passwords and the free-text field where people typed things they shouldn't have.

discloseNow.label: Disclose it today
discloseNow.result: You told users within hours. It hurt, but Dana called it "a model response".

quietPatch.label: Patch it quietly and say nothing
quietPatch.result: Patched and quiet. For now. Breaches have a way of being found twice.

blameIntern.label: Blame a junior employee
blameIntern.result: The statement mentions "an individual's error". The team knows exactly who you mean, and so do they.

lawyerUp.label: Let your lawyer handle the response
lawyerUp.result: Your lawyer drafted a disclosure so careful it was almost reassuring.

theStoryDrops.title: Dana is running a story
theStoryDrops.body: Dana Okafor has sources, documents and a publication date. She's giving you a chance to respond before it goes live.
theStoryDrops.denyWorked: Your denial held. The story ran small, on a Friday, under a celebrity divorce.
theStoryDrops.denyFailed: Dana published the documents alongside your denial. The internet did the rest.

comeClean.label: Come clean before it runs
comeClean.result: You gave her the whole story. It's ugly, but it's yours, and it's over.

deny.label: Deny everything
deny.result: You sent a firm denial and turned your phone over on the desk.

fightInCourt.label: Fight it in court
fightInCourt.result: Your lawyer sends a letter on heavy paper. The story is delayed, softened and expensive.

offerExclusive.label: Offer Dana a bigger exclusive instead
offerExclusive.result: Dana trades the scandal for a bigger story you hand her. She knows what you did.

diligenceQuestions.title: The analysts have questions
diligenceQuestions.body: Hollowpine's associate has been reconciling your deck against your database. The numbers do not reconcile. She has a spreadsheet with a lot of red in it.

confess.label: Admit the deck was generous
confess.result: Margot was quiet for a long time, then said "thank you for telling me". That was worse.

doubleDown.label: Insist the numbers are right
doubleDown.result: You explained a very creative definition of "active".
doubleDown.cause: doubled down on inflated numbers during due diligence

blameSpreadsheet.label: Blame a broken spreadsheet formula
blameSpreadsheet.result: A VLOOKUP took the fall. Your finance intern is quietly updating their CV.

dataBrokerExposed.title: Your data turned up somewhere
dataBrokerExposed.body: A researcher traced a broker's "anonymised" dataset back to your users. It took her an afternoon. She's written a blog post with diagrams.

apologise.label: Apologise and end the deal
apologise.result: A full apology and a cancelled contract. Some users leave; the ones who stay notice you meant it.

spinIt.label: Call it "personalised partnerships"
spinIt.result: Nobody believed the phrase "personalised partnerships", but it did trend.

giveItBack.label: Donate the proceeds to a privacy charity
giveItBack.result: You gave the money away publicly. It doesn't undo it, but people respect the receipt.

burnoutWave.title: The team is running on fumes
burnoutWave.body: Response times are slipping, tempers are short and someone cried in the stairwell. You've been asking a lot for a long time.

weekOff.label: Give everyone a week off
weekOff.result: The office was silent for a week. People came back looking like people.

pizzaParty.label: Throw a pizza party
pizzaParty.result: You ordered twelve pizzas. Four were eaten. The rest became a metaphor.

pushThrough.label: Push through, it's nearly done
pushThrough.result: It was not nearly done. Someone resigned by email at 2am.

hireHelp.label: Hire help immediately
hireHelp.result: Three engineering candidates are ready to talk. The team exhales slightly.

rivalCopycat.title: {{rival}} shipped your feature
rivalCopycat.body: Brexton Hale just launched something that looks exactly like your product, with a slightly worse font and a much bigger ad budget.

outship.label: Out-ship them
outship.result: The team takes it personally. Output jumps; so does the overtime.

sue.label: Have your lawyer send a letter
sue.result: The letter worked. {{rival}} quietly rolled the feature back and Brexton posted about "innovation".

publicCallout.label: Call them out publicly
publicCallout.result: Your side-by-side screenshot went viral. Brexton blocked you, which also went viral.

ignore.label: Ignore them and focus
ignore.result: You lose a few users to the shiny copy. The rest stay, mostly out of loyalty.

securityChecklist.title: The security checklist
securityChecklist.body: A customer's IT team sent a 140-question security questionnaire. Honest answers would require a proper review first. It costs four thousand dollars and a week.

doIt.label: Pay for a proper review
doIt.result: The reviewers found the things reviewers find. You fixed them.

skipIt.label: Skip it and tick "yes" to everything
skipIt.result: Questionnaire returned in twenty minutes. Every answer was "yes".

delegate.label: Hand it to your security-minded engineer
delegate.result: They took it as a gift. Most of the holes are closed by Friday.

buyBadge.label: Buy a compliance badge for the website
buyBadge.result: The footer now has a shiny shield icon. It means nothing, beautifully.

cofounderConflict.title: Your co-founder is unhappy
cofounderConflict.body: Your co-founder wants to talk, and the calendar invite is titled "us". They feel sidelined, overruled and underpaid in equal measure.

shareControl.label: Give them real ownership of an area
shareControl.result: You hand them the product roadmap. They seem ten years younger.

buyOut.label: Buy them out
buyOut.result: You paid thirty thousand dollars and kept the vested shares civil. The team is shaken.

mediation.label: Bring in a founder coach
mediation.result: Three sessions with a coach who says "sit with that" a lot. It helps, annoyingly.

ignoreIt.label: Let it blow over
ignoreIt.result: You said you'd think about it. You didn't. They noticed.

acquisitionOffer.title: Omnivast wants to buy you
acquisitionOffer.body: Omnivast, which owns the search engine, the email and possibly the moon, has made an offer at a premium to your last valuation. They'd like an answer this week.
acquisitionOffer.counterFailed: Omnivast walked away from your counter. Their next quarterly report mentioned "building in-house".

accept.label: Accept the offer
accept.result: You signed. The champagne was good. The integration plan was forty pages long.

counter.label: Counter at a higher price
counter.result: You asked for more and waited by the phone like it was 1997.

decline.label: Decline and keep building
decline.result: You said no. The team cheered. {{rival}} took the meeting next.

leakIt.label: Leak the offer to Dana
leakIt.result: The story ran under "Omnivast circles hot startup". Your next round just got easier.

acquihireOffer.title: An acqui-hire offer
acquihireOffer.body: A large company would like your team, but not your product. They're offering jobs and a modest payout. Your runway says to listen.
acquihireOffer.holdOutFailed: They hired a different team that same afternoon.

accept.label: Take the deal
accept.result: Your team will have badges, lunch and a product that will be "sunset" on Friday.

holdOut.label: Hold out for better terms
holdOut.result: You asked for more. They said they'd "circle back".

decline.label: Decline and fight on
decline.result: You said no. Your co-founder bought everyone a beer with their own money.

raiseRequest.title: {{name}} wants a raise
raiseRequest.body: {{name}} closes the meeting room door and says they've been offered more elsewhere. They'd rather stay. They'd rather stay and be paid more.

equityInstead.label: Offer equity instead of cash
equityInstead.result: {{name}} takes the equity and starts reading about tax.

notNow.label: Not right now
notNow.result: {{name}} says they understand. Their LinkedIn profile updates that evening.

fancyTitle.label: Offer a grander title
fancyTitle.result: {{name}} is now a Principal Staff Lead. Nobody knows what it means, including them.

recruiterCalling.title: {{rival}} is calling {{name}}
recruiterCalling.body: {{name}} mentions that a recruiter from {{rival}} has been in touch three times this week. The offer is very good. They wanted you to hear it from them.

matchOffer.label: Match the offer
matchOffer.result: You match it. {{name}} stays, and the salary bands now have a dent in them.

appealToMission.label: Remind them why they joined
appealToMission.result: You talk about the values you wrote together. {{name}} stays, for the mission.

letThemGo.label: Wish them well
letThemGo.result: {{name}} leaves for {{rival}} with a farewell cake and your blessing.

askWho.label: Ask who at {{rival}} is hiring
askWho.result: {{name}} looks uncomfortable. Brexton hears that you asked, within the hour.

weekendPrototype.title: {{name}} built something
weekendPrototype.body: Over the weekend, {{name}} prototyped a feature nobody asked for. It's rough, a little hacky and genuinely brilliant.

greenlight.label: Greenlight it
greenlight.result: {{name}} is beaming. The prototype goes on the roadmap, held together with tape.

shelve.label: Shelve it, stay focused
shelve.result: You explain focus. {{name}} explains nothing, and goes quiet in stand-up.

takeCredit.label: Demo it at the all-hands as your idea
takeCredit.result: The demo goes great. {{name}} sat in the front row and watched you do it.

firstHireWantsTitle.title: {{name}} wants to be VP
firstHireWantsTitle.body: {{name}}, one of your first hires, wants the VP Engineering title now that the team is growing. They've earned loyalty. Whether they can manage is another question.

promote.label: Promote them
promote.result: {{name}} is VP in all but salary band. They now spend Tuesdays in calendar Tetris.

hireAbove.label: Hire an experienced VP above them
hireAbove.result: Two seasoned VP candidates are ready to meet. {{name}} has stopped smiling at stand-up.

foundingEngineer.label: Make them "Founding Engineer"
foundingEngineer.result: A title with history and no reports. {{name}} puts it on their email signature in bold.

growingPains.title: The garage is full
growingPains.body: There are now more people than chairs, and the dehumidifier has developed a personality. It's time to decide where the company actually works.

leaseOffice.label: Lease a real office
leaseOffice.result: Exposed brick, a plant wall and a lease that will outlive several of your strategies.

goRemote.label: Go fully remote
goRemote.result: The garage is a garage again. The team picks a time zone to argue in.

coworking.label: Take desks at a coworking space
coworking.result: Free coffee, a ping-pong table and a founder next to you who won't stop pitching.

kombuchaTap.title: The kombucha question
kombuchaTap.body: A petition with nineteen signatures asks for a kombucha tap in the kitchen. Someone has already chosen a brand.

install.label: Install the tap
install.result: Kombucha flows. The kitchen smells faintly of vinegar and gratitude.

memo.label: Send a memo about priorities
memo.result: Your memo about "focus" was screenshotted into the team chat with a sad face.

vote.label: Put it to an all-hands vote
vote.result: Democracy chose a cheaper brand. Everyone is mostly happy, which is democracy.

viralMoment.title: You're trending
viralMoment.body: A celebrity posted about {{company}}. It's mostly positive. Traffic is up a hundred-fold and the servers are making a noise.

rideIt.label: Ride the wave
rideIt.result: Thousands of sign-ups, a few outages, and a meme with your logo in it.

scaleServers.label: Pay for more servers right now
scaleServers.result: The servers held. The new users stayed. The cloud bill sent its regards.

stayHumble.label: Thank them and stay humble
stayHumble.result: A gracious reply. Fewer sign-ups, more respect.

bigCustomer.title: A big customer wants something custom
bigCustomer.body: A household-name company will sign a large contract if you build one feature only they need. Their procurement team uses words like "bespoke".

buildIt.label: Build it for them
buildIt.result: The contract is signed. Your roadmap now includes a feature called "the Hargreaves thing".

decline.label: Politely decline
decline.result: You said no. They said they respect it. They did not sign.

promiseLater.label: Promise it "next quarter"
promiseLater.result: They signed on the promise. Next quarter is a long way off. Until it isn't.
promiseLater.cause: promised a customer a feature you never planned to build

cloudBill.title: The cloud bill has become sentient
cloudBill.body: This month's infrastructure invoice is longer than your first business plan, and one line item just says "miscellaneous" with a large number next to it.

optimise.label: Spend a month optimising
optimise.result: The team found three forgotten servers and a database nobody could explain. Costs fall.

pay.label: Pay it and move on
pay.result: Paid. You've decided not to read the line items, for your health.

migrate.label: Migrate to a cheaper provider
migrate.result: The migration is cheaper, messier and has introduced a bug that only happens on Thursdays.

conferenceInvite.title: You're invited to speak
conferenceInvite.body: Upward Summit wants you on a panel called "The Future of the Future". You'd pay your own travel, but the audience is investors.

accept.label: Accept
accept.result: You said "it's early days" twice and got a round of applause anyway.

sendCofounder.label: Send your co-founder
sendCofounder.result: Your co-founder was brilliant and has mentioned it about nine times since.

decline.label: Decline and get work done
decline.result: You stay home and get an extra thing done this month.

investorDinner.title: Dinner with Margot
investorDinner.body: Margot invites you to a small dinner at a restaurant with no prices on the menu. She says it's purely social. Nothing with Margot is purely social.

go.label: Go and listen
go.result: You learned about three companies, two divorces and one very good wine.

pitchHer.label: Pitch her over dessert
pitchHer.result: Margot puts down her spoon. "Fine. Send me terms."

patentTroll.title: A patent claim
patentTroll.body: Pendleform Intellectual Ventures LLC, registered at a post office box, claims to own "displaying information on a screen in response to a user". They'd like a licence fee.
patentTroll.won: The court threw it out. Your lawyer framed the ruling.
patentTroll.lost: The judge found for the troll. You now pay a licence fee for scrolling.

fight.label: Fight it with your lawyer
fight.result: Your lawyer cracked her knuckles. This one's going to court.

settle.label: Settle quietly
settle.result: You paid. The LLC sent a thank-you note, which felt like a threat.

ignore.label: Ignore the letter
ignore.result: The letter goes in a drawer. Letters like this don't stay in drawers.

aiPivotPressure.title: Shouldn't you be an AI company?
aiPivotPressure.body: Every pitch at demo day mentioned agents. Margot forwards you three articles with the subject line "thoughts?".

pivotDeck.label: Rewrite the deck around AI
pivotDeck.result: Slide two now says "agentic". Investor interest doubled. So did the engineering backlog.

renameIt.label: Add "AI" to the product name
renameIt.result: {{company}} AI is live. Nothing else changed. Some people noticed.

stayCourse.label: Stay the course
stayCourse.result: You reply to Margot: "We're focused." The team is quietly relieved.

pressProfile.title: Dana wants a profile
pressProfile.body: Dana Okafor wants to spend a week with {{company}} for a long-form profile. Full access, she says. She means it.
pressProfile.foundSomething: Dana's profile is mostly kind. One paragraph is not, and it's the one everyone quotes.

openBook.label: Give her full access
openBook.result: Dana sat in on everything. The profile ran this morning.

polishedPr.label: Offer a managed half-day
polishedPr.result: A tidy piece with a staged photo. Dana noted it was "carefully arranged".

decline.label: Decline
decline.result: Dana says "no problem" in the tone journalists use when it is a problem.

fundingWinter.title: The market turns
fundingWinter.body: A famous fund just marked its portfolio down by half and three unicorns announced "strategic refocusing" on the same morning. Venture money is about to get very quiet for a while.

cutNow.label: Cut costs before you have to
cutNow.result: Budgets trimmed, perks paused, the office plants now water themselves.
cutNow.cause: were caught in the funding winter

layOffEarly.label: Lay off a fifth of the team now
layOffEarly.result: Painful and early. Your runway thanks you; the people who left do not.
layOffEarly.cause: were caught in the funding winter

lastDoor.label: Call Margot before the door closes
lastDoor.result: Margot takes the call. "You have until Friday," she says.
lastDoor.cause: were caught in the funding winter

holdNerve.label: Hold your nerve
holdNerve.result: You tell the team nothing changes. You hope you're right.
holdNerve.cause: were caught in the funding winter
